questions.q: What did the young man have in his mouth when he came into the stable?
choices: A pipe
An apple
A whistle
A straw
questions.evidence: a young man with a pipe in his mouth lounged into the stable

questions.q: What did the hostler ask Towler to do?
choices: Put down some hay from the loft, but lay down his pipe first
Lock the stable door and take the key up to the house
Fetch water from the pump for all the horses in the stalls
Clean the traveler's horse and rub down its legs

questions.q: What woke Black Beauty in the night?
choices: Thick, choking smoke in the stable
James calling his name from the yard
The loud clang of the fire bell
Ginger kicking at the wall of her stall
questions.evidence: the stable seemed full of smoke

questions.q: Why would the horses not go with the first frightened hostler?
choices: He was so frightened that he frightened them more
They were tied fast to their stalls with iron chains
They were fast asleep and would not wake up
The stable door was locked and he had no key
questions.evidence: he seemed in such a hurry and so frightened himself that he frightened me still more

questions.q: What did James tie over Black Beauty's eyes to lead him out?
choices: The scarf from his neck
A wet horse blanket
His own cap
An empty feed bag
questions.evidence: he took the scarf off his neck, and tied it lightly over my eyes

questions.q: How did James's voice sound when he came into the burning stable?
choices: Quiet and cheery, as it always was
Loud and angry, shouting at the hostlers
Shaky and scared, as if he might cry
Silent, for he did not say a word
questions.evidence: James' voice, quiet and cheery, as it always was

questions.q: Why did Ginger say Black Beauty's whinny was the best thing he could have done?
choices: Hearing him outside gave her courage to come out
It warned the firemen that horses were still inside
It woke the master, who was asleep at the hotel
It frightened the hostlers into opening the doors
questions.evidence: had she not heard me outside she would never have had courage to come out

questions.q: What did the master call James when he came out with Ginger?
choices: "My brave lad!"
"You foolish boy!"
"My clever horse!"
"Well done, Towler!"

questions.q: What arrived pulled by two horses as they were leaving the yard?
choices: The fire-engine
The mistress in a carriage
A doctor's gig
The London mail coach

questions.q: What rule of John Manly's did Black Beauty think should be the rule everywhere?
choices: Never allow a pipe in the stable
Always lock the stable door at night
Never travel with the horses after dark
Always keep a full water bucket by the door
questions.evidence: never to allow a pipe in the stable
